defaults.text: Fresh stories, useful ideas, thoughtful updates

css: .tb-h-tall-editorial{position:relative;background:var(--tb-color-surface);color:var(--tb-color-text)}.tb-h-tall-editorial__inner{max-width:var(--tb-h-tall-editorial-width);margin:auto;padding:0 24px}.tb-h-tall-editorial__brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--tb-color-secondary);text-decoration:none;font-weight:900}.tb-h-tall-editorial__logo{width:38px;height:38px;object-fit:contain}.tb-h-tall-editorial__brand-name{letter-spacing:-.025em}.tb-h-tall-editorial__nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tb-h-tall-editorial__link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:9px 11px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-weight:750}.tb-h-tall-editorial__link:hover{color:var(--tb-color-primary)}.tb-h-tall-editorial__parent{position:relative}.tb-h-tall-editorial__submenu{position:absolute;z-index:20;top:100%;left:0;min-width:190px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--tb-color-surface);display:none;box-shadow:0 16px 38px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-secondary) 14%,transparent)}.tb-h-tall-editorial__submenu .tb-h-tall-editorial__link{display:flex}.tb-h-tall-editorial__parent:hover>.tb-h-tall-editorial__submenu,.tb-h-tall-editorial__parent:focus-within>.tb-h-tall-editorial__submenu{display:grid}.tb-h-tall-editorial__chevron{font-size:10px;opacity:.65}.tb-h-tall-editorial__mast{min-height:160px;padding:30px 0;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;align-content:center;gap:12px}.tb-h-tall-editorial__brand-name{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:44px}.tb-h-tall-editorial__note{max-width:560px;color:var(--tb-color-muted)}.tb-h-tall-editorial__menu-row{padding:9px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);display:flex;justify-content:center}@media(max-width:820px){.tb-h-tall-editorial__row,.tb-h-tall-editorial__top,.tb-h-tall-editorial__glass,.tb-h-tall-editorial__frame,.tb-h-tall-editorial__pill{flex-wrap:wrap;height:auto;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:14px}.tb-h-tall-editorial__nav{width:100%;order:5}.tb-h-tall-editorial__submenu{position:static;box-shadow:none}}@media(max-width:560px){.tb-h-tall-editorial__inner{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}.tb-h-tall-editorial__row{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.tb-h-tall-editorial__search{width:100%!important}}
name: Tall Editorial Header
description: A tall editorial masthead with brand statement and centered navigation.
